## Valmont to Participate in D.A. Davidson Industrials and Services Conference


September 16, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.valmont.com/node/16556/pdf)


OMAHA, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 16, 2026-- Valmont® Industries, Inc. (NYSE: VMI), a global leader that provides products and solutions to support vital infrastructure and advance agricultural productivity, will be attending the 25th Annual D.A. Davidson Industrials and Services Conference on Thursday, September 24th in Nashville, Tennessee. John Schwietz, Chief Financial Officer and Renee Campbell, Senior Vice President, Capital Markets and Risk, will present at 11:20 a.m. Central Time.


A live webcast can be accessed at the time of the event through the[Investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54604945&newsitemid=20260916998662&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors&index=1&md5=fcbc2e7c99a3d7ecd0dd670ff6d0de7d) page of Valmont’s website. A replay of the presentation will be available approximately 24 hours after the event and will remain available on the[Investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54604945&newsitemid=20260916998662&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors&index=2&md5=a35b9d1abf1bfe09c7d542d6d9787f21) page of[Valmont.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54604945&newsitemid=20260916998662&lan=en-US&anchor=Valmont.com&index=3&md5=209fd642ca6b2ff982481310010c41fa) for 90 days. The company will also host investor meetings throughout the day.


**About Valmont Industries, Inc.**


For more than 80 years, Valmont has been a global leader that provides products and solutions to support vital infrastructure and advance agricultural productivity. We are committed to customer-focused innovation that delivers lasting value. Learn more about how we’re *Conserving Resources. Improving Life.®* at[valmont.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54604945&newsitemid=20260916998662&lan=en-US&anchor=valmont.com.&index=4&md5=141bdf9eaabf0fe067f58a87234d4c73)
